If it's close to breaking, consider throwing it.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 2 |durability = 12 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Boko Spear}} Boko Spears are [[Weapon]]s that can commonly found in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[West Necluda]]. They are used primarily by regular [[Bokoblin]]s in these areas. They belong to to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons created by Bokoblins.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Carved from [[Tree Branch]]es, these Spear are also used by Bokoblins to skewer and [[Cooking|Cook]] [[Food]]s. The [[Hyrule Compendium]] recommends throwing them if they are close to breaking. Scanning the {{BotW}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]] has a chance of spawning a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Boko Spear. Being made of wood, Boko Spears will float on [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] if they are dropped. They will also burn if exposed to a [[Scorching Climate]] or [[Fire]], which is a tactic used by Bokoblins near [[Campfire]]s. Finally, they do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during a [[Thunderstorm]], and they cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_004" |Life = 12 |Power = 2 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 3 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 5 |BuyingPrice = 9 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Spear }} Boko Spears reappear in {{AoC}}, once again being wielded by [[Bokoblin]]s, starting with [[The Battle of Hyrule Field]] [[Scenario]]. A Boko Spear can be obtained for use by [[Link]], as well as upgraded and enhanced, but is outclassed by other [[Weapon]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Boko Spear Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Boko Spear ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bokoblin Gear * Dragonbone Boko Spear * Spiked Boko Spear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bokoblin Gear, Spears, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
